title: Dependent Parents and the Temporary Total Rate under Disability Compensation
content:
The parent additions in a Disability Compensation temporary total past-due are as many parent additions as the parent maximum of 2 when the award records at least 2 dependent parents, one parent addition when it records exactly one dependent parent, and nothing when it records none. Each applies to every temporary total month and, as every addition in a temporary total past-due, is taken from the 100 percent tier: 176.88 for each parent.

Dependent parents recorded are the parent additions on the award less the parent removals.

| Parents recorded | Each temporary total month |
|---|---|
| 0 | Nothing |
| 1 | 176.88 |
| 2 | 353.76 |
| 3 or more | 353.76 (the maximum of 2) |
